note: What a server sends to change or reset the voice a unit speaks with. The header names the unit.

bits.name: reset
bits.note: Set where the unit returns to its own voice; no name follows.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: voice
fields.note: The voice's name, ended by a zero byte.

fields.name: leftover
fields.note: One byte where no name follows. A server leaves it as it found it, so it carries values never written for this message; a reading end skips it.
